page.overview:
Who is Greta?

Arena Tycoon Greta is the second Frontier Brain of the Hoenn region. She is in charge of the Battle Arena.

Greta is medium height, slim girl. She has short blonde hair in a bob with a fringe and big blue eyes. She wears a sky blue Lycra jumpsuit underneath her robe, which is short and black with cerise pink edges. On her feet she wears cerise pink trainers with white toe caps and white laces.

Greta only appears in Emerald. She appears after 28 consecutive tournament wins for the Silver Badge. She then appears after 56 consecutive tournament wins for the Gold Guts Badge.
